records.name: Black Pearl Chamber Orchestra
records.summary: A Philadelphia chamber orchestra that gives concerts and runs community programs. The Inreach programs include a conducting program, an open rehearsal, and a leadership program that bring people closer to the musicians and the creative process.
records.what_you_do: Attend a concert from the performances list, go to an open rehearsal, or take part in an Inreach program (iConduct! or Orchestrating Leadership). The sign-up details for these are on their own pages.

schedule.text: Concerts are listed on the performances page. The next dated listing is Handel's Messiah with the Jeremy Winston Chorale on December 20, 2026, at Salem Baptist Church of Abington.

records.name: Center for Emerging Visual Artists
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit, founded in 1983, that supports emerging visual artists through a fellowship, citywide exhibitions, and community outreach. It also runs the Philadelphia Open Studio Tours, where visitors see artists' studios.
records.what_you_do: Tour artists' studios on the Philadelphia Open Studio Tours, or volunteer for the tours. You can also see the exhibitions, go to events such as the ART PARTY and auction, or join as an artist member. The site lists outreach to older adults and a Hand-in-Hand community program.

schedule.text: The Philadelphia Open Studio Tours have a 2026 directory and map (tour dates not read). Events are on the Upcoming Events page.

locations.label: Mailing address (mail only, per the site)
locations.address: The Philadelphia Building, 1315 Walnut Street, Suite 300

cost.text: Tour and event costs are not stated on the pages read

first_step.how: Join the mailing list on the site, then look at the POST 2026 directory and map to find studios on a tour. The site's POST page lists volunteer roles.
first_step.basis: Several public ways in are listed (mailing list, tours, volunteer page), but the pages read give no event dates.

records.notes: The newest evidence is the 2026 POST directory and map, dated by year only. The upcoming events path guessed on the site returned 404, so the event list was not read. The batch address for this group looks like a residential apartment, so it was not used. The mailing address from the site is used instead.

records.name: Philadelphia Classical Guitar Society
records.summary: A nonprofit that presents classical guitar concerts, a festival, and a competition in Philadelphia and Newtown, PA. It also runs a guitar ensemble and hosts guitar salons.
records.what_you_do: Buy tickets for the concert season, or go to a guitar salon, the festival, or the competition. The site also lists a Concert Ensemble, a guitar orchestra you can join, but the page gives no audition or join details.

schedule.text: Concert season for 2026 to 2027, with dates from November 7 and 8, 2026 through March 2027. Times are not shown on the home page.

cost.text: No prices on the home page; ticket and membership prices are on linked pages

first_step.basis: Concerts are sold to the public, with dates and ticket links on the group's own site

records.name: Philadelphia Sinfonia
records.summary: A nonprofit that gives young musicians in the Delaware Valley high-level orchestra playing experience. It runs four ensembles and puts on concerts and events the public can attend.
records.what_you_do: Attend a concert or event, such as A Very Sinfonia Halloween on October 31, 2026. Young musicians can audition for an ensemble (the page lists auditions for 2026 to 2027), and the group also lists volunteer, donation, and job options.

schedule.text: Next dated events: A Very Sinfonia Halloween on Saturday, October 31, 2026, and a concert on Sunday, November 22 (year not shown on the page, taken as 2026). Rehearsal times are not shown.

cost.text: No ticket, audition or membership prices on the page; general donation link only

first_step.basis: Concerts are listed publicly with dates and the page offers a mailing list. Playing in an ensemble needs an audition.

records.name: Pig Iron Theatre Company
records.summary: A Philadelphia theater ensemble that makes new performance work, trains performers at its own school, and rents its studios to other artists.
records.what_you_do: Take training through Pig Iron School, come to a student showing or a public show, or attend the Lecoq Symposium or the yearly benefit. The company also lists jobs and internships.

schedule.text: Shows, student showings and events are listed by date on the company website. Class times were not shown on the pages read.

cost.text: No prices were shown for classes or tickets on the pages read.

records.name: Directors Gathering
records.summary: A community for theater directors in Philadelphia that holds free salons and gatherings where directors look at their process, try projects they might not otherwise attempt, and meet each other.
records.what_you_do: Come to a free salon or community gathering in person or on Zoom, sign up for the free Basic membership for event access and digital resources, or donate.

schedule.text: Events are listed by date. The newest dated event is September 21, 2026, 6 to 8 pm, in person in Philadelphia. Summer Salon Series sessions are free. The site says a longer membership relaunch is planned for 2026.

cost.text: The events shown are free and the Basic membership is free. Donation amounts are not listed.

first_step.how: Sign up for the free Basic membership, or RSVP for the next free event on the Directors Gathering site (some events ask for an RSVP by a set date).
first_step.basis: Events are free and open to the public, and the site explains how to RSVP and join the free tier.

records.notes: No public email or phone was readable on the page read. The website is listed on the September 21 event flyer. There is no exact interest tag for a theater director community, so interests is empty. The Basic membership tier launched in March 2025.

records.name: MusiCoLab
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that helps local writers and composers build new musicals, with showcases and readings that audiences can attend.
records.what_you_do: Audiences can join the mailing list and attend showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series. Writers and composers can look at the site's Submissions page to send in their work. Feedback is also collected through a page on the site.

schedule.text: Showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series are announced on the site, but the page shows no dates.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list on musicolab.org to hear about the next showcase, or use the Submissions page if you write musicals or songs.
first_step.basis: Showcases are open to audiences and the site gives a clear sign-up and submission path, though no dates are posted.

records.notes: Batch address 1721 S 13th St comes from IRS and Cultural Fund lead data and is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The contact page has only a form, with no email or phone. No dated events were found; '2025 Workshop Red & Black' is named by year only, so the status is probably_active rather than active. records.name: A Book a Day
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that gives books to children and families, runs family events and a mobile clinic, and runs a children's writing and illustration program.
records.what_you_do: Come to an open family event such as Children's Day or the Freedom to Learn fundraiser, or visit an exhibit at The Study. Volunteers can help on service days. Kids can enter the Philly Writers contests when one is open, though none was open when this was checked.

schedule.text: Children's Day was Aug 22, 2026 at Parkway Central Library. The Voices Alive! exhibit ran Sept 11 to 21, 2026 at The Study at University City. The Freedom to Learn fundraiser is Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm, at The Study.

cost.text: Prices for the fundraiser and other open events are not stated.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on abookadayprogram.com, then come to the Freedom to Learn fundraiser at The Study on Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm.
first_step.basis: Open events are listed with dates and places, and a newsletter sign-up is offered, so a newcomer can attend without a prior connection.

records.notes: Batch address matches the site. The Philly Writers page gives no dates, ages or sign-up steps. The Jan 19, 2026 MLK Day of Service has passed. The homepage lists a book review published Sept 29, 2026, with a separate update date of Aug 16, 2026. The contact page was not read.

records.name: Germantown Community Broadcasting
records.summary: The community radio station for Germantown, on the air as G-Town Radio at 92.9 (WGGT-LP). It runs local live shows and podcasts, and it hosts artist residencies with public gatherings.
records.what_you_do: Tune in to live shows and podcasts, come to the public gatherings for the current artist residency, or ask the station how to get involved in its programs.

schedule.text: Live shows run in the morning and at midday (for example 8 to 10 am, 10 to 11 am, 11 am to 12 pm, and noon to 1 pm); three artist residency gatherings were announced for August 2026, with more dates to come on the site

cost.text: The site lists no prices for listening, events or membership.

first_step.how: Listen online at gtownradio.com, then email info@gtownradio.com or call 215.609.4301 to ask how to volunteer as a host or producer
first_step.basis: The Get Involved section says 'Volunteer Today' but gives no details on roles or how to start, so the way in is unclear beyond contacting the station.
